posts.text:
The Save America Act is simple: Go back to Election Day—not election month—and require voters to prove they are who they say they are. 

That’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.
posts.summary: Backs voter ID requirements to restore election integrity and public trust
posts.quote:
The Save America Act is simple: Go back to Election Day—not election month—and require voters to prove they are who they say they are. 

That’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.

posts.text: The SAVE Act restores confidence in our elections by ensuring only American citizens vote in American elections.
posts.summary: Supports SAVE Act to ensure only U.S. citizens vote in elections
